findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 風險因子明列：若出現競爭或替代技術，商譽（$21,341.2，約占總資產 62%）可能減損；收購風險評估亦提及「來自 AI 的市場顛覆」易感性。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: If future operating performance at one or more of our business units were to fall significantly below current or expected levels, if competing or alternative technologies emerge, if discount rates rise, or if business valuations decline, we could incur a non-cash charge to operating income.

findings.claim: 10-K 揭露其 AI 產品依賴第三方 LLM 供應商（OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Microsoft），供應商可能漲價且 Roper 未必能轉嫁給客戶。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: As AI becomes more central to our offerings, our exposure to pricing changes from these providers increases, and we may not be able to pass such cost increases on to our customers.

findings.claim: Seeking Alpha 2026-01 文章稱股價自高點下跌近 40%，歸因於 AI 引發的軟體股拋售。
findings.source: Seeking Alpha 'Roper Technologies: At A Crossroad'

note: 搜尋結果多為 Simply Wall St／Seeking Alpha 等聚合與意見稿，僅提及 AI 顛覆疑慮（RBC 2025-10 降評、股價自高點跌近 40%），無具名替代產品；未取得可逐字複製原文，故不列 finding。 線索 1 條，程式核實 0 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
